{{Top|leg}}
'''The Vortex''' was a group of freelance [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that was devoted to anarchy throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and the co-opting of [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] channels. When the group sliced into a military datapad, it was shut down by a more experienced slicer.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Twist Their Arm}}</ref>
